Definition: Tsillethai, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zilthai is the name of two Israelites, one a Benjamite and one a captain who joined David at Ziklag. In 1 Chronicles 8:20, Zilthai, and Eliel. The fuller story is told on the Zilthai profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zilthai matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
